names: a change that waits for its folder keeps the member another change added meanwhile
a Bot deleted while a change waits for its folder is not added back
a group deleted while a change waits for its folder stays deleted
create_bot stores a photo, and update_bot changes and clears it
a photo that cannot be read changes nothing, and a non-Main Bot cannot set another Bot's
a relative file link a member writes reaches the group, and another Bot, as a full path
a move that fails while the plugin unloads hands its input back to the part it left
a move that never started keeps carry and one pause note in the inbox; a retry adds none
an ordinary failure during the move is still a warning, not the unload note
an ordinary failure in the move that never started wakes the part at once
a marked earlier part hands its kept input on after a restart, once, and is archived
a marked part that stayed current is woken for its kept input, once, in order
unmarked earlier parts are never resolved by the restart pass
a state write that fails as a switch ends is warned about, not left unhandled
